text:
michelle: Heads-up — I'm seeing integration-watchdog stop paging oncall for ~15m. Alerts are getting suppressed by automation :rotating_light:

sam: Which channel/automation?

michelle: incidents -> integration-watchdog. suppression window toggled to 'quiet' during the canary deploy, looks like.

incident-bot: [system] Suppression engaged by automation (id: aw-77). Suppressing 32 alerts. Reason: rate-limit.

ryan_oncall: @michelle I'm oncall and got nothing. Can you dump the last webhook delivery/logs? :eyes:

michelle: curl output below:
```
POST /hooks/alert 200 OK
x-debug: header missing
{"status":"delivered","dest":"pagerflow","attempts":0}
```

ingrid_sre: Seeing a heartbeat gap from orchestrator: 2025-06-12T14:02:11Z -> 2025-06-12T14:12:20Z. watchdog didn't trigger fallback path.

sam: Are automations supposed to auto-fallback to SMS after suppression?

michelle: Yes — fallback path is sms-relay but it's gated behind a "manual-escalation" flag.

ryan_oncall: That flag was flipped in the last deploy (rollout: canary-94). I rolled it back ~5m ago.

incident-bot: [system] Suppression cleared after manual override by ryan_oncall. Resuming pages.

michelle: Pages are flowing now. I see retries to sms-relay from 14:12:41 -> success.

sam: Any customer impact?

ingrid_sre: Customer-facing alerts queued for ~12m; highest severity is degraded webhook ingestion affecting 3 customers. CS has been notified.

ryan_oncall: Mitigation: re-enabled manual-escalation fallback and force-replayed queued alerts. Monitoring for duplicate pages.

michelle: Replay log:
```
POST /internal/replay?since=2025-06-12T14:00Z&until=2025-06-12T14:12Z
replayed: 28 alerts -> 3 sms sent
```

sam: Thanks. Can we add a guard to prevent suppression toggles during deploys?

ingrid_sre: Filing P0 follow-up and scheduling a postmortem. Tagging ops-team and deploy-team.

ryan_oncall: Resolved for now, staying oncall watch for 30m.

michelle: Ack. Proposal in postmortem: add automation semaphore + automatic fallback to sms after 30s of suppression.

incident-bot: [system] Thread closed by michelle.
